title: The payload of a signed RateBound document

RateBound.description: RateBound is the kind RateBound (0036 "Inside sluis", the limits of `entry`); id "default". Each field is one limit of the token buckets that `entry` keeps in the temp kind RateWindow: a count of requests that a bucket admits in a burst and refills in one window. A field that is absent keeps the built-in default, and a value above the maximum built into the release is refused by the loader, so the document tightens or loosens within what the release allows and never past it. The document is optional: with none, every limit is its default. These are protective bounds against cost and are not quota.

token_client.description: `/token` per client: a client is its id, in the form or in the Basic header; a client the installation does not declare shares one bucket.

recovery_address.description: The recovery routes (`/passkeys/add` and `/passkeys/register`) per source address. These routes name no client.

RateLimit.description: RateLimit is one limit: `limit` requests in `window`. A bucket holds at most `limit` tokens, and refills at `limit` tokens in one `window`. The loader holds the limit between 1 and 100000 and the window between 1 second and 1 hour (the longest a RateWindow item lives).

window.description: A duration: one whole number and one unit of s, m, h or d, such as 900s, 15m, 12h or 30d.
